title: Why Is My Windshield Frozen When It's 37? #Shorts
description:
Why is your windshield frozen when it's not even freezing? The 37 on the thermometer is the air, about four feet up. Your glass leans back and stares at the clear night sky, losing invisible heat, so it drops below freezing and water vapor turns straight into ice on it. Plus why your neighbor's car under the carport stays clear.

Explained in 60, podcast edition
